description: This file defines the 'Location' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a location with various attributes such as name, country, address, phone, and related employees. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods for each property.
external_methods: getters and setters for entity properties

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Entity class representing a location with properties such as name, country, address, and contact details, mapped to the 'ohrm_location' table in the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the location.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the location.

methods.name: getProvince
methods.description: Returns the province/state of the location.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any notes about the location.
